main_topics.reason: User came because infliximab stopped working and wanted to know alternatives to the proposed switch; this drove most turns.
User was furious at being brushed off and treated as awkward, and wanted to be part of the decision.
Opened with fury and returned to feeling heard, ending with relief at having a plan.
Discussed over several turns as a concrete question to raise; user had not been offered these tests.
User asked directly about a second opinion on the NHS and worried how it would look.
Bot drafted a question list the user accepted and said they would take in.
Mentioned as the background for the switch and the reasons it might happen.

output.summary: User on infliximab for four years, which stopped working, was angry that their consultant announced a switch to Humira and dismissed questions about alternatives. The bot validated their feelings, explained other biologic classes, suggested asking about drug level and antibody testing, drafted a list of questions, and covered the NHS second opinion route. The user said they now had a plan rather than a grievance and would book an appointment.
